action_items: (Optional) Set explicit min-height on Recharts ResponsiveContainer wrappers in Manager Social tab to silence chart width(-1) warnings.

(Verify) Customer profile header showing dashes for Janet Masinde (3846911099035) in this run while iteration 1 had it populated — confirm BI customer/{id} returns profile.customer_name and lifetime stats consistently.
critical_code_review_comments: social.py classify_pending invokes the LLM synchronously on every /api/social/feedback call when any item has sentiment=null (server.py line 394-395). This blocks request handling for several seconds on first hits. Consider: (a) rate-limit to once per minute via a flag/lock, or (b) only kick a background task and return current state, or (c) cap to a smaller batch (e.g., 10).

_ensure_seed creates a fire-and-forget classify task with asyncio.create_task but the warm GET /summary then *also* schedules another classify task — easily overlaps and double-classifies the same items. Add an in-process lock or use update_one with filter {'sentiment': None} (already does, fine) but skip rescheduling if a job is already running.
POST /api/social/handles/{customer_id} backfills feedback by author_handle but never validates that customer_id exists in the BI system — same gap flagged for /api/messages in iteration 1.

POST /api/social/feedback/{id}/link does not require customer_id to be valid (no BI check) and does not bump customer_id back to null on un-link (no un-link route exists at all). Add DELETE or pass customer_id=null to clear.
social.py is 540 lines with mock seed inline. When real BigQuery wiring lands, split into social/{seed.py, classifier.py, router.py} for testability.

classify_batch falls back to sentiment='neutral' on any LLM exception — silently masks key revocation / quota errors. Log at error level and surface a /api/social/health diagnostic endpoint for the manager to detect classifier outage.
EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is read at module import time (line 199) — if the key is rotated, the backend must be restarted to pick it up. Read inside classify_batch instead.
Inbox.jsx 'Link to customer' uses prompt-style textbox + Enter/Search button only — no debounced search-as-you-type. Minor UX gap consistent with iteration 1's customer search behavior.

ManagerDashboard.jsx SocialTab and Inbox.jsx both fetch /api/social/feedback?limit=100 (Inbox) and /summary (Manager) on every tab switch with no caching — fine for v1 but inefficient when the corpus grows.
